[GB] DSS Drank Round 2 - 40% Monokit
« on: Sun, 04 October 2026, 13:18:44 »
Introducing DSS Drank R2! After over 5 long years, this classic color way is back! It features updated kitting to cover most modern 40% keyboard layouts. Convex DSA spacebars, QAZ legends, multiple novelties and LAE/ISO keys are now included. Drank R2 brings that purple fix you’ve been waiting for!


Details:

Monokit: $130 (MoQ 50)
Color codes: Light Purple (RCJ), Dark Purple (RDA), White (WA)
Doubleshot ABS in DSS profile (1-2-3-4-3 sculpt)
Convex DSA Space Bars
Manufactured by Signature Plastics
Trashcon Icons by Trashman
Group buy period: October 9, 2026 - November 6, 2026
Manufacturing time: 12 weeks
Fulfillment: February 2027

Vendor: https://keyboardarcade.xyz




A colemak/colemak-dh child kit is being ran by MostCallMeAndy in the 40s Keyboard discord. Please fill out the IC form, if you are interested!!

Colemak IC Form: https://forms.gle/RGDf7bF9Y5dRcfwx9

Re: [GB] DSS Drank Round 2 - 40% Monokit
« Reply #17 on: Thu, 05 November 2026, 12:32:08 »
We are currently at 37 sets sold. I’m going to extend the end date for this group buy until this Sunday to allow a bit more time for us to get closer to MoQ. We are just a handful of sets away from making this happen.

After SA Paperwork launches and concludes, I will be switching things up a bit on kitting. I want to target a lower MoQ (25) moving forward. This means that some “obscure” coverage will be dropped, with preference given to the more popular modern layouts out there. It has been quite difficult for a 40% set to hit 50 MoQ recently on its own without a buyout. I always strive to offer wider coverage to make as many people happy as possible, but these larger kits are proving to be unsustainable.

I hope we finish strong over the next few days and we can get round 2 into the production queue. Thank you to everyone for joining and their continued support. ❤️
